Contract GenerateLoanLetterAndAgreementModule::generateLoanAgreement(): Boolean {
	definition:
		currentAgreement: LoanAgreement = self.CurrentLoanAgreement
	precondition:
		self.CurrentLoanRequest.oclIsUndefined() = false
	postcondition:
		result = true and
		currentAgreement.oclIsNew() and
		currentAgreement.Content = 'standard content' and
		self.CurrentLoanRequest.AttachedLoanAgreement = currentAgreement and
		LoanAgreement.allInstances()->includes(currentAgreement)
}
